entries.source: Keigo-তে সবচেয়ে জরুরি প্রশ্ন ‘কোন শব্দটি কঠিন?’ নয়—‘কার action উঁচু করছি?’ 尊敬語 সম্মানিত ব্যক্তির action/অবস্থা উঁচু করে। নিজের বা নিজের in-group-এর action-এ এটি দিলে ভুল perspective হয়।
entries.target: Sa Keigo, ang pinakamahalagang tanong ay hindi 'aling salita ang mahirap?'—kundi 'kaninong action ang itinataas ko?' Ang 尊敬語 ay itinataas ang action/kalagayan ng iginagalang na tao. Kung ilalagay ito sa sarili o sariling in-group na action, magiging maling perspective.

entries.source: Customer, teacher, senior, client/company outsider—context অনুযায়ী সম্মানিত। পরিবার/নিজের কোম্পানির boss-কে outsider client-এর সামনে 尊敬語 দিয়ে উঁচু করা Japanese uchi-soto নীতিতে সাধারণত ভুল; নিজের group নিচু রাখা হয়।
entries.target: Customer, teacher, senior, client/company outsider—iginagalang ayon sa context. Ang pagpapataas ng pamilya/sariling boss ng kompanya gamit ang 尊敬語 sa harap ng outsider client ay karaniwang mali sa prinsipyo ng uchi-soto ng Hapon; pinapanatiling mababa ang sariling grupo.

entries.source: Person-এর নামের সঙ্গে さん/様 এবং verb honorific আলাদা স্তর; দুটো একসঙ্গে স্বাভাবিক। তবে double keigo overdo করবেন না।
entries.target: Ang さん/様 kasama ng pangalan ng tao at verb honorific ay magkaibang antas; natural ang dalawa nang sabay. Ngunit huwag sobrahan ang double keigo.

entries.source: 尊敬語 subject-এর action বদলায়; নিজের ‘আমি যাই’ কখনো いらっしゃいます নয়—参ります (Lesson 50)।
entries.target: Binabago ng 尊敬語 ang action ng subject; ang sariling 'pupunta ako' ay hindi kailanman いらっしゃいます—参ります (Lesson 50).
Ang dapat tandaan

entries.source: প্রথমে subject/actor mark করুন; সম্মানিত actor হলে 尊敬語।

Huwag itaas ang sariling action.

entries.source: নিজের 行く-কে尊敬語 いらっしゃる নয়; humble 参る বা neutral 行く।
entries.target: Ang sariling 行く ay hindi 尊敬語 na いらっしゃる; humble na 参る o neutral na 行く.

entries.source: Passive-এর একই form দিয়ে সম্মানিত ব্যক্তির active action বলা
entries.target: Pagsasabi ng active action ng iginagalang na tao gamit ang parehong form ng passive

entries.source: Form passive হলেও meaning active: 先生はもう帰られました = শিক্ষক ইতিমধ্যে ফিরেছেন (তাঁকে সম্মান)। Agent に নেই এবং সম্মানিত ব্যক্তি action করেন—এগুলো clue।
entries.target: Kahit passive ang form, active ang meaning: 先生はもう帰られました = umuwi na ang guro (paggalang sa kanya). Walang agent na に at ang iginagalang na tao ang gumagawa ng action—ito ang mga clue.

entries.source: Special honorific বা おVになります-এর তুলনায় এটি তুলনামূলক সহজ/কম marked respectful form। Business speech-এ বহুল।
entries.target: Kumpara sa special honorific o おVになります, ito ay medyo madali/hindi gaanong marked na respectful form. Madalas ito sa business speech.

entries.source: Context ছাড়া 先生は呼ばれました ambiguous: ‘শিক্ষককে ডাকা হয়েছে’ passive, অথবা rare honorific ‘শিক্ষক ডাকলেন’। Particle ও situation দেখে ধরুন।
entries.target: Kung walang context, ambiguous ang 先生は呼ばれました: 'tinawag ang guro' passive, o bihirang honorific na 'tumawag ang guro'. Unawain ito sa pamamagitan ng pagtingin sa particle at sitwasyon.

entries.source: Passive meaning হলে agent に; honorific meaning-এ subject নিজেই action করেন।
entries.target: Kung passive meaning, ang agent ay に; sa honorific meaning, ang subject mismo ang gumagawa ng action.
Kailan darating ang guro?
Nabasa na ng department head ang dokumento.
Umuwi ang presidente kanina lang.

entries.source: 先生は学生にほめられました。（‘শিক্ষক প্রশংসা করলেন’ বলতে）
entries.target: 先生は学生にほめられました. (para sabihing 'pinuri ng guro')

entries.source: Agent に থাকলে ‘শিক্ষক ছাত্রের দ্বারা প্রশংসিত’ passive। Honorific active-এ original object を।
entries.target: Kung may agent na に, 'pinuri ng estudyante ang guro' passive. Sa honorific active, ang original object ay を.
Paggawa ng karaniwang verb na honorific

entries.source: お + stem + になる পুরো unit। 先生は手紙をお書きになりました।
entries.target: Ang お + stem + になる ay buong unit. 先生は手紙をお書きになりました.

entries.source: Sino-Japanese する noun-এ সাধারণত ご: ご説明になります, ご利用になります। কিন্তু common exceptions/lexical preference আছে; dictionary/fixed phrase অনুসরণ করুন।
entries.target: Sa Sino-Japanese na する noun, karaniwang ご: ご説明になります, ご利用になります. Ngunit may common exceptions/lexical preference; sundin ang dictionary/fixed phrase.

entries.source: Stem এক mora হলে সাধারণত pattern চলে না: 見る→お見になります ✕; special ご覧になります। いる→いらっしゃる। する→なさる।
entries.target: Kung isang mora ang stem, karaniwang hindi gumagana ang pattern: 見る→お見になります ✕; special na ご覧になります. いる→いらっしゃる. する→なさる.

entries.source: おVします হলো humble (Lesson 50); おVになります হলো honorific।
entries.target: Ang おVします ay humble (Lesson 50); ang おVになります ay honorific.

entries.source: Special honorific থাকলে সেটিই সাধারণত বেশি স্বাভাবিক।
entries.target: Kung may special honorific, iyon ang karaniwang mas natural.
Umuwi na ang guro.
Isusulat mo ba ang pangalan mo rito?
Gagamitin mo ba ang serbisyong ito?

entries.source: সম্মানিত teacher subject: おVになります; おVします humble।
entries.target: Iginagalang na teacher subject: おVになります; ang おVします ay humble.
Pangunahing special honorific verbs

entries.source: সাধারণ pattern-এর বদলে নির্দিষ্ট 尊敬語
entries.target: Tiyak na 尊敬語 sa halip ng karaniwang pattern

entries.source: いらっしゃる, おっしゃる, なさる, くださる-এর polite ます form-এ り নয়, い: いらっしゃいます, おっしゃいます, なさいます, くださいます।
entries.target: Sa polite na ます form ng いらっしゃる, おっしゃる, なさる, くださる, hindi り kundi い: いらっしゃいます, おっしゃいます, なさいます, くださいます.

entries.source: ご存じです negative ご存じではありません। 知りません-এর মতো ご存じません না বলাই standard।
entries.target: Ang ご存じです negative ay ご存じではありません. Ang hindi pagsasabi ng ご存じません tulad ng 知りません ang standard.

entries.source: 召し上がる food/drink উভয়; ご覧になる visual ‘দেখা’।
entries.target: Ang 召し上がる ay kapwa food/drink; ang ご覧になる ay visual na 'pagkita'.

entries.source: Special form আগে বাছুন; double お召し上がりになる ✕ (over-keigo)।
entries.target: Piliin muna ang special form; ang double na お召し上がりになる ✕ (over-keigo).
Ano ang kakainin/iinumin ng bisita?
Natandaan ko ang sinabi ng guro.
Alam mo ba ang lugar na ito?
Naglalaro ng golf ang presidente.

entries.source: なさる-এর irregular polite form なさいます।
entries.target: Ang irregular polite form ng なさる ay なさいます.
'Pakiusap, gawin/tanggapin' nang may paggalang

entries.source: Vてください-এর respectful formal alternative; announcement, customer service, signage-এ প্রচলিত। お入りください, お座りください, ご記入ください।
entries.target: Respectful formal alternative ng Vてください; karaniwan ito sa announcement, customer service, signage. お入りください, お座りください, ご記入ください.

entries.source: সব verb mechanicalভাবে নয়; special/fixed form শিখুন: 見てください→ご覧ください, 食べてください→お召し上がりください।
entries.target: Hindi lahat ng verb ay mekanikal; matutunan ang special/fixed form: 見てください→ご覧ください, 食べてください→お召し上がりください.

entries.source: কাজটি সম্মানিত শ্রোতা করবেন—তাই尊敬語। নিজের action নয়।
entries.target: Ang iginagalang na tagapakinig ang gagawa ng gawain—kaya 尊敬語. Hindi ito sariling action.

entries.source: お/ご prefix-এর lexical convention আছে; する-noun সাধারণত ご।
entries.target: May lexical convention ang お/ご prefix; ang する-noun ay karaniwang ご.
Maghintay ka muna rito.
Suriin ang nilalaman na ito.
Gamitin ito nang walang pag-aatubili.

entries.source: 来る-এর尊敬語 いらっしゃる।
entries.target: Ang 尊敬語 ng 来る ay いらっしゃる.

entries.source: 2. ‘সভাপতি নথি পড়েছেন’—おVになります বলুন।

entries.source: সম্মানিত ব্যক্তি নিজে action করলে尊敬語। Special verb থাকলে সেটি, না থাকলে Vられる বা おVになります; formal request-এ おVください। নিজের action-এ এগুলো নয়।
entries.target: Kung ang iginagalang na tao mismo ang gumagawa ng action, 尊敬語. Kung may special verb, iyon; kung wala, Vられる o おVになります; sa formal request, おVください. Hindi ito para sa sariling action.
